endowment_summary: Two consecutive IPhO gold medals (2015, 2016). Best Female Asian Pacific Participant at IPhO 2016. Only girl on Vietnam's team. One of two youngest competitors. Nicknamed 'Thảo còi' (thin/small) — weighed only 40kg. MIT full scholarship. Prodigy-level physics ability.
inherited_summary: From Nam Dinh province in Vietnam. Le Hong Phong High School (specialized school). Family described as living in 'ngôi nhà nhỏ' (small house). No family wealth or domain connections documented. Limited resources.
ecosystem_summary: Le Hong Phong High School (specialized school in Nam Dinh). Training at Hanoi Pedagogical High School. Vietnam IPhO team training. MIT full scholarship (VND6.3 billion). Limited early ecosystem access in provincial Vietnam; national olympiad program was key pathway.

endowment_summary: First Indian girl to win gold at IPhO 2010. Stood 12th among 376 participants, first among girls. Ranked 18th nationally in IIT JEE (all-India female topper). Topped Jamnabai Narsee School with 97%. Admitted to MIT. Prodigy-level physics and mathematical ability.
inherited_summary: From Mumbai. Attended Jamnabai Narsee School (elite private school in Mumbai) and IITians PACE (expensive private coaching academy). Mother Zarana Sarda supportive. Family invested in elite coaching and education.
ecosystem_summary: Jamnabai Narsee School (elite private school). IITians PACE (elite IIT coaching academy in Mumbai). Homi Bhabha Centre at TIFR (one-month special training). Sathaye College labs (opened for her experiments). MIT admission. Elite coaching ecosystem in Mumbai.

endowment_summary: Won three gold medals in three different International Science Olympiads (IMO, IOI, IPhO) over three consecutive years. Also won IJSO gold. Youngest IPhO gold medalist from Taiwan at 14. Setting an unprecedented record — perhaps first in the world to achieve such multi-domain olympiad success. Prodigy-level across math, physics, and informatics.
inherited_summary: From Taiwan. Taipei Municipal Jianguo High School (elite public school in Taiwan, highly competitive admission). No specific family wealth documented but attended elite school.
ecosystem_summary: Taipei Municipal Jianguo High School (elite public high school in Taiwan). Taiwan science olympiad training program with NTU professors. Four-stage team selection process (nearly 2,900 students, only 5 chosen). National Taiwan Normal University professors trained the team.

endowment_summary: Perfect score at IMO 2012 (42/42, 1st place — only perfect scorer). IMO gold medal 2011 (2nd place, 40/42) and 2013 (3rd place, 40/42). Also Singapore Physics Olympiad Gold and Australian Informatics Olympiad Gold (perfect score). Four IMO medals total (bronze, silver, 3 golds). Prodigy-level across math, physics, and informatics.
inherited_summary: From Singapore. No specific family wealth or domain connections documented. Singapore's strong public education system provided the foundation.
ecosystem_summary: Singapore education system (strong STEM focus). Singapore math olympiad training program. Multiple international olympiad participations (IMO, Physics, Informatics). Singapore's national olympiad team selection and training infrastructure.
